t: This is the site of Wood Lane, a former Underground station in Shepherd's Bush. It has closed, but it was once an important stop. From 1908 to 1920 it was the western terminus of the Central London Railway, the forerunner of today's Central line, and it was later served by the Central line itself. The station was designed by Stanley Heaps, an English architect who lived from 1880 to 1962. Heaps designed a number of London Underground stations, as well as depots and garages for London Transport.
